repos_data.description: Auditable memory layer for AI agents: zero-LLM-call local ingest (~10ms/msg, air-gapped), matches Mem0 on accuracy at ~1000x lower ingest cost, bi-temporal belief-state, MCP server. Honest LoCoMo/LongMemEval benchmarks. Open source (Apache-2.0).
The associative memory layer for LLM agents — recall by association, not just similarity.
